changeinfo.changes:
Deadman's Cross Version 1.9.1

Update Details
  • New "Auto-sell" function allows you to automatically sell 1★ and 2★ Deadmen after hunts.
  • Deadmen carrying Deadman gear now spawn on hunts.
  • Up to 50 Deadmen can now be selected as feeding and Redeath material.
  • Energy drinks can now restore over the maximum stamina amount.
  • The maximum number of items in one trade bracket that can be sent has been increased to 20.
  • The abilities "Regenerate (Auto HEA restore)" and "Meditate (Auto PSY recovery)" now have an activation limit of 10.
  • Fixed various other minor issues.

Deadman's Cross Version 1.9.0

Update Details
  • "Deadman Gear" feature added.
  • Deadman "scrapping" feature added.
  • Fixed various other minor issues.

Deadman's Cross Version 1.8.1

Update Details
  • Random reward job feature added.
  • New abilities added.
  • Deadman Coin purchase history and restrictions can now be displayed.
  • Fixed an issue where player personas (icons) were not displaying correctly in the Boneyard Rankings screen.
  • Fixed various other minor issues.

Deadman's Cross Version 1.8.0

Update Details
  • A user ranking list has been added to the Boneyard.
  • New rankings have been added to the Boneyard.
  • A visual effect is now displayed in the Boneyard results screen when a user's rank goes up.
  • A specialized persona is now used for users who have achieved the Bonemaster ranking.
  • Fixed the RELOAD animation speed issue in the hunting screen.
  • Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when the catalog is completed.
  • Fixed various other minor issues.

Deadman's Cross Version 1.7.2

Update Details

  • Normal and limited-time jobs can now be placed "on hold.
  • When customizing hordes, cards can now be removed from a horde by flicking.
  • An ability relearning feature for Deadmen has been added, along with the item "Recall Gun," which is used specifically for this feature.
  • New search job maps have been added.
  • Boost item effects are now reflected in Deadman stats.
  • Stat adjustments by Deadman type are now more clearly displayed.
  • Battle skip speed has been accelerated.
  • 4★ and 4★+ Deadmen are now sorted separately in the Deadman screen.
  • Fixed an issue where an .html tag was displayed in text when Deadman Coins were purchased.
  • Fixed an issue where certain abilities did not activate when several abilities were used in conjunction.
  • Fixed various other minor issues.

Deadman's Cross Version 1.7.0

Update Details

  • Event hunting area feature added.
  • Fixed an issue regarding silhouette spawns that perform ranged attacks in Clayton Cemetery.
  • Fixed an issue where the game would freeze in the "Morris Penitentiary" and "Gould Square (alt)" areas after certain player actions are taken.
  • Fixed an issue where rewards would not be displayed in the results screen after defeating official players in the Boneyard.
  • Fixed various other minor issues.
